review_text: May 2024 — This is easily one of the busiest spots in SM Lanang Premier, likely due to their consistent international quality. The donuts are always fresh and delicious. However, being a standalone kiosk in the middle of the mall hallway significantly limits the dining space. It’s often too crowded to enjoy a quiet meal. Because it's so busy, maintenance is a struggle; tables are often sticky or cluttered with the previous diners' mess. It might be time for them to consider moving to a proper storefront with a dedicated seating area to better serve their high volume of customers.

Krispy Kreme Doughnuts outlets need no introduction to Philippines People, their doughnuts are commonly given as a gift, or as a Pasalubong which is the Filipino tradition of travellers bringing gifts from their destination to people back home. Of course they are a deluxe product and much appreciated. This particular outlet is on the ground floor of the mall and immediately visible when you walk in. There are ample tables and chairs so you can enjoy your purchase with a drink if you want a rest while shopping. Of course there are not just plain doughnuts but there are a variety of toppings and fillings. A first class product in first class surroundings.
